author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at a community that can't survive a day without a controversy. The GTA community has been a modding hotbed for decades now and unfortunately one mod that experiments in paid tiers could put the community in danger legally because of their distributing of official Rockstar assets and constant fighting with the broader community. Thanks for watching!

title: Rockstar Games Might Come After The Community Over This...
